question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

This course will provide you with a __rudimentary__ knowledge of Sanskrit.
solution:
The correct answer is “**Elementary**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The word '**rudimentary**' refers to an early stage of development or a simplistic form.(आदिम) 

 
 
• Example- His understanding of the subject was rudimentary.
 
 
 
• '**Elementary**' means basic or rudimentary. It refers to something in the simplest or beginning stage.(प्रारंभिक) 
 
 
• **Example**- Her knowledge about computers is pretty elementary.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word 'rudimentary' is 'Elementary'.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options:
 
• **Extensive**: Covering or affecting a large area. (व्यापक)
 
• **Exhaustive**: Highly comprehensive or complete. (सम्पूर्ण)
 
• **Intricate**: Very complicated or detailed. (जटिल)
